name: Blue Puni
description: A squishy monster found pretty much everywhere. It's so weak even a child can defeat it. Still, they tend to attack in groups and may catch unsuspecting adventurers unaware.

name: Green Puni
description: Slightly stronger than a standard Blue Puni. It's a little harder and more bouncy, which it uses to its advantage when it attacks.

name: Red Puni
description: A much stronger, more aggressive Puni. It's quite hot-blooded, and will chase after you if it spots you.

name: Gold Puni
description: A shining gold Puni which has consumed too many metals. It has a uniquely metallic odor. It's quick to run away from danger.

name: Black Puni
description: A completely black and extremely hard Puni. Many theories have tried to explain its existence, such as having a core of burnt silicon, but none have been verified.

name: Fake Puni
description: A Puni unlike any other. To most it may look the same, but to the trained eye the differences are obvious.

name: Special Puni
description: A prismatic rainbow Puni. This extremely powerful specimen would cause difficulty for even the most experienced adventurers.

name: Master Puni
description: The king of all things Puni. It acts as a kind of Puni commander, but its considerable size and strength make it a formidable opponent even on its own.

name: Beast
description: A bipedal beast noted for its fluffy fur. The Gatekeeper is the weakest of the beasts, and thus the lowest rank. But despite its cute appearance, it can still pose quite a danger.

name: Guard
description: A beast one rank up from Gatekeeper due to its ability to wield a larger weapon. When a Gatekeeper ranks up, they're naturally inclined to look after the weaker.

name: Beast
description: The highest beast rank. It's powerful enough to fight without relying on weapons. Reaching this rank means you're a full-grown adult.

name: Horned Beast
description: A larger species of rabbit with fearsome horns. The tail may look especially puffy, but it doesn't actually contain much fur. Don't let one of these hit you--it WILL hurt.

name: Icicle Beast
description: A rabbit with crystal horns hard as diamond. They're found in cold regions, so they have thick fur which leads to stronger defenses.

name: Fortunate Heart
description: A cute, angelic rabbit. It has a unique heart pattern, and legend has it that if you can touch that area, you will find your love requited.

name: Cheery Flower
description: An intriguing flowery monster. It absorbs nutrients via its roots, helping the flower on its head bloom. The white cotton puffs on its hands will harden over time.

name: Sunshade Grass
description: A flower-like monster that feeds off sunlight. It withers after even a day without sun, so it's constantly seeking sunny areas.

name: Aluma
description: A plant monster that scatters poisonous spores as a defense mechanism when it senses danger. The buds in its hands stay closed in order to gather poison.

name: Dustshooter
description: A mysterious monster that lives in a cauldron. One theory says this cauldron was part of a failed synthesis and gave birth to the creature.

name: Seedcaster
description: A monster constantly engulfed in blazing heat. The boiling cauldron keeps the creature warm and vital, so if the monster leaves the cauldron it will be weakened.

name: Hidedecker
description: A monster that can enclose itself in its cauldron to charge up its energy. The flower found on its head does not exist anywhere else in nature.

name: Ravenous Bat
description: A quite eye-catching pink monster. It lives mainly in dark areas, and is often mistaken for some kind of ghost.

name: Demonic Hunter
description: A fanged bat monster that gives off an ominous aura. If you're bitten, you'll find yourself engulfed in darkness, confused and unable to move for a period of time.

name: Cold Blood
description: A bat monster found mainly in cold regions. Its fangs emit ice energy, freezing anything it bites. Some claim that the supersonic waves it emits cause blizzards.

name: Ghost Mushroom
description: A giant mushroom monster. It uses its long tongue as a deadly weapon. Experienced explorers can look at the monster's tongue and determine the state of the health.

name: Antidote Mushroom
description: A poisonous looking mushroom. It shoots out poisonous spores from its tongue. Mushrooms you can collect from this creature are not poisonous themselves.

name: Mush-Wolf
description: A monster with a hat-looking cap. Unlike the other mushroom monsters, it has sharp teeth you'll notice when you get up close, since it will lunge and try to bite you.

name: Plains Turtle
description: A tortoise monster that dwells in grassy plains. Its hard shell is surprisingly sharp, and can lead to serious injury.

name: Hidden Stone
description: A monster with a shell made from stacked rocks. It lives in dry climates like deserts and rocky mountains. When it wants to sleep, it will dig a hole and withdraw into its shell.

name: Spiked Turtle
description: A monster with a pointed shell. The unique shape causes a tornado when it spins around. It appears black in low light, so it is known as Black Shell in some worlds.

name: Mountain Jellyfish
description: A jellyfish-type monster found in the mountains. Its ability to float allows it to live on land, and half of its body is made of water, which it absorbs through the air and plants.

name: Flower Parasol
description: A monster with flowery patterns on it. It contains a special venom which can eventually petrify anything it attacks.

name: Devil's Tentacle
description: A monster that mutated after absorbing too much poison. It uses this poison to attack, and is highly resistant to poison itself.

name: Forest Guard
description: A golem made of wood. It was once part of some ancient ruins, but eventually found its way to the nearby forests, which it defends. It can use wood to repair itself.

name: Stone Breaker
description: A golem made of stone. These stones are composed of a unique mineral which it can also use to repair itself.

name: Magnagardener
description: A special type of golem that defends specific locations. They have a set range they'll defend, so as long as you stay out of their area, they'll leave you alone.

name: Crimson Raider
description: A monster that looks like an eagle with beastly legs. In addition to its wings, it's covered in bright red fur, and the fire it breathes can easily melt rock.

name: Bernfeld
description: An odd monster with a chicken's head, snake scales, and a poison-spitting tail. It's extremely aggressive and will attack anything that comes close.

name: Bolt Eagle
description: A monster that looks like a huge, majestic eagle. It's said to fly at the speed of light, with a sound of thunder. Once it notices you, escape is all but impossible.

name: Fallen Knight
description: An armored skeleton knight. It's said to be composed of the spirits of knights that have fallen in battle, though it doesn't fight like a knight.

name: Flammecanne
description: One of the strongest dragons in the world. Its fire breath can melt rock in an instant, and its speed, strength, and battle skills are unparalleled.

name: Valanar
description: One of the strongest dragons in the world. It can create tornadoes from water, and even while sleeping it can cause storms which make the oceans roil and rumble.

name: Clay Statue
description: A monster completely shrouded in mystery. All anyone knows is that it's lightning fast, and only the most highly trained warriors stand any chance against it.

name: Siegel
description: A monster that was sealed by a sage using the power of alchemy.
